CR-X9 v2: surface-conforming armor panels, finger bones, sockets, LOD0/1/2 (52.7k/22.1k/7.3k tris), 22 clips. Graded PROTOTYPE after visual review.

changelog: 1.1 (Claude): removed 12 duplicate character entries (manifest claimed 257, 245 unique files exist); added up_axis per asset; added crimson_knight_CRX9_rigged. Original kept as asset_manifest.v0.4_original.json.
1.2 (Claude): registered assets/materials PNGs as textures, ui/icons PNGs, and references/original_images for in-game billboards/loading screen.
1.3 (Claude): concept boards sliced into assets/images (config/image_catalog.json) and used in-game.
1.4 (Claude): CR-X9 v2, three vehicle prototypes (+LOD1), Red Citadel level.
1.5 (Claude): New Gotham city kit (36 assets + building LOD1s).
1.6 (Claude): NPC/enemy families (14 rigged humanoids on the CR-X9 skeleton + patrol drone).
1.7 (Claude): 18 gadget / fictional-weapon models (gear_<itemId>) with grip origins, socket attach, anchors and Gear_* clips.

textures.usage: hero armor; crimson trim on props/vehicles

image_catalog.notes: Individual hero/vehicle/gadget/animation/world/NPC/prop/effect images cut from the concept boards in references/original_images.
